scripts.check: npm run check:structure && npm run check:lockfile && npm run check:migration-order && npm run check:hosting && npm run test:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.security:check: node scripts/security-audit.mjs && node --test tests/launch-admin.test.mjs tests/security-harden.test.mjs tests/security-auth-behavior.test.mjs tests/admin-core.test.mjs tests/mfa-flow.test.mjs && node --test tests/staging-runner.test.mjs
scripts.launch:check: npm run check:production-env && npm run release:gate
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run security:check
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run audit && npm run audit:production && npm run e2e
scripts.release:gate:staging: npm run release:gate && npm run staging:security
scripts.release:gate:production: npm run check:production-env && npm run release:gate && npm run staging:security
